level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks comparison.routes._aggregate_period

issue.title: Hide unsupported DOCSIS errors in Before/After Comparison

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug and found no regressions, but Break My Fix found that the fixed comparison.routes._aggregate_period raises UnboundLocalError (on a variable starting 'corr_errors_su...') when a snapshot has both correctable and uncorrectable DOCSIS error counters set to None. That is exactly the unsupported-counter case this fix targets, so check that variable's initialization on t…

labels.label: intended
labels.reason: The issue asks to hide `cmp-chart-errors` when the selected periods have unsupported error counters. Adding `errors_supported`/`*_supported: False` flags to the empty-period summary is purely additive and leaves the existing keys and values unchanged, so it serves that goal.
